title: apply's lead share check reads the whole source line, so a long line's clipped passage that does not answer is still applied
goal: Found by the fresh-context review of SP-x5gjv4r7, item ST-732j5ufa: ql_apply's key-word share gate (more than half of the question's key words) reads the whole kb/_self line, while the anchor phrase and the eval's text gate read the clipped passage pack prints, so a long line (the tools.md row of tests.py, 5608 characters) holding the key words past the clip passes the share and a passage that does not answer (the tests.py CI command text, 0 of 5 key words for 'how does the test lock wait for another holder') becomes an SQ- row. The share is read from the printed passage, as the anchor is.

run:
import sys,tempfile,pathlib,types
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import ql_apply as a
CLIP="The zqxwidget runner installs pytest-xdist through uv run frozen on every build"
LEAD=CLIP+" and much later the plomkinator frobnicator quuxifies every plomkin on commit."
t=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
g=types.SimpleNamespace(fresh=lambda:None,measure=lambda:{"n":1,"passed":1,"failed":[],"chars":{"EV-x":100},"offkb_good":0},rules_eval=lambda:t/"e.csv",rules_aliases=lambda:t/"a.csv",rules_pack=lambda x:{"text":"coverage: weak\n\n## kb/_self/w.md\n- kb/_self/w.md:7 "+CLIP+"\n"},rule_line=lambda r:("w.md",LEAD),token_counts=lambda:{},anchored=lambda row:row[5] in LEAD,alias_terms=lambda rules=True:{})
r,human=a.rules_one({"id":"F-1","kind":"rules","observed":{"verdict":"weak"}},{"question":"which plomkinator frobnicator quuxifies every plomkin"},g,{"chars":{"EV-x":100},"offkb_good":0})
state=(r or {}).get("state");print("state of a lead whose printed passage holds none of the key words:",state)
sys.exit(0 if state!="applied" else 1)

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 3 of 19, "Checks that passed broken work: ledger citations, lint paths, the held-out reword gate and the query-log apply guards"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise: ql_apply.rules_one on a lead whose printed passage holds none of the key words returns state applied (the repro exits 1 on the base, run at planning 2026-10-12). Order: before ST-s4cihfge (ql_apply.py and test_redact.py are shared).
